gloss: the second one; the second (in a sequence)

definitions.explanation: The second item in a series of countable things, or the second point in a list of reasons or steps. Built from the native counter {二|ふた}つ plus the ordinal suffix 〜{目|め}.

examples.english: It's right at the second corner.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will explain the second reason.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧、⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Get off at the second stop from this station and go up the stairs.

notes:
The suffix 〜⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ turns a count into an ordinal, so ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧ means "two items" but {二|ふた}つ{目|め} means "the second one."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧: the second corner (in directions)
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧: the second traffic light
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: the second reason
- {二|ふた}つ{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to get off at the second stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二番目|にばんめ}→二番目：30362_nibanme⟧: the second — interchangeable in ranking contexts, and preferred for order of rank
- {二回目|にかいめ}: the second time — counts occasions, not objects
